one_line_description.value: Bright Data is a web data platform that discovers, accesses, extracts, and interacts with public websites for scraping, search, and browser automation.
one_line_description.quote: Discover, access, extract, and interact with any public website.

has_public_api.quote: API Access - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using an API key/token.

api_type.quote: openapi: 3.0.1 info: title: Bright Data API

api_breadth.value: Broad multi-product REST API: Scraper API with thousands of pre-built scrapers, Scraper Studio, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Browser API, datasets; read-write.
api_breadth.quote: The same call works for every one of Bright Data's thousands of pre-built scrapers: change the `dataset_id` over HTTP, or call a different method in the SDK.

docs_url.quote: Guides, quickstarts and API references for Bright Data Scraper API, Scraper Studio, Web Unlocker API, SERP API, proxies, datasets and Bright Data MCP.

auth_methods.quote: Authenticate with Bright Data using 1 of 2 methods: API Access with an API key or Native Access with proxy username and password.

access_model.quote: New accounts get 5,000 free credits every month, no credit card required

access_notes.value: Free self-serve signup with 5,000 credits/month and no credit card; API keys are generated in Account settings and only admin accounts can create them; unfunded accounts have a 1,000 req/min SERP rate limit; higher volume requires adding funds or a paid plan.
access_notes.quote: New accounts get 5,000 free credits every month, no credit card required

rate_limits.value: SERP API: 1,000 req/min for unfunded accounts, with HTTP 429 above the limit; limits can be raised by adding funds or contacting sales.
rate_limits.quote: Unfunded accounts are subject to a rate limit of 1,000 req/min.

sdk_languages.quote: One of: - cURL - Python 3.9+ with the Bright Data Python SDK: `pip install brightdata-sdk` - Node.js 20+ with the Bright Data JavaScript SDK: `npm install @brightdata/sdk`

verdict_reason: Bright Data exposes a broad multi-product REST API with documented API-key authentication, official Python and JavaScript SDKs, and a vendor-hosted MCP server. A new account receives 5,000 free credits per month with no credit card, and API keys are self-generated, so credentials are self-serve. The main friction is a 1,000 req/min SERP rate limit for unfunded accounts and sales contact for higher volume.
open_questions: OAuth scopes/permissions are not documented in the cited sources; an OAuth 2.1 MCP setup page appeared only as a search snippet and was not included in SOURCES.
No documented sandbox or test environment was found in the provided sources; the free tier may serve as a de facto test environment but this is not explicitly stated.
API versioning and deprecation/sunset policy was not found in the cited sources; only an OpenAPI spec version (1.0.0) and docs build version were visible.
No community or third-party MCP servers were found in the evidence (GitHub and MCP registry checks returned no results).
Production plan tiers and pricing gates beyond the free monthly credits are not fully specified in the cited pages.
